scope: Publicly documented metadata categories and schemas across major social-media and social-content platforms
important_limit: There is no finite, stable list of every social-media app worldwide. This inventory uses major platform categories and official public documentation; it is not a backend telemetry dump or exhaustive extraction of every app.

platform_documentation_examples.X: X publicly documents categories including account/profile information, device and connection information, location, usage/log data, cookies, advertising information, and public API access.
platform_documentation_examples.Instagram_Meta: Meta/Instagram documentation describes account/profile, content and metadata, device/network information, activity, location, cookies/similar technologies, partner information, and inferences/advertising categories.
platform_documentation_examples.Snapchat: Snap publicly documents Snap/Chat metadata such as date, time, sender and receiver, plus account, device, activity and location categories.
platform_documentation_examples.YouTube: YouTube documents search/watch activity, account data, location, device information, recommendations/advertising use, and content metadata. YouTube also supports C2PA-based content-origin disclosures when valid credentials are present.

recommended_collection_method: Catalog official privacy policies, developer/API documentation, help-center documentation, data-download documentation, and public transparency reports. Preserve the exact source and date rather than scraping private accounts or platform infrastructure.
security_boundary: No backend telemetry acquired without authorization
status: Global public metadata schema uploaded for comparative research. Platform-specific fields should be validated against current official documentation before treating them as authoritative.
